newsitem.title: USA: Shell says Capline Feb nominations 1,064,070 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Shell says Capline Feb nominations 1,064,070 bpd.

text.p: Shell Oil Co said Monday that nominations on the Capline crude pipeline for February totalled 1,064,070 barrels per day (bpd).
The actual allocation on the pipeline for January totalled 926,835 bpd, compared with nominations for that month of 971,501 bpd, Shell said.

The pipeline, a major artery linking the Gulf Coast and the Midwest, has a capacity to run 1.11 million bpd and is operated by Shell and subsidiaries of six other companies: Amoco Corp, Ashland Inc, British Petroleum Co Plc, USX-Marathon Group, Southcap Pipeline Co and Texaco Inc.
The 40-inch line runs from the St. James terminal in Louisiana north to the Patoka terminal in Illinois.
